verdict: Meta ads are delivering strong returns; overdue deliverables are being resolved now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaigns returned $7,525.15 in revenue on $1,366.18 in ad spend — a 5.51x return — and both purchases and that return rate climbed roughly 18% in the most recent week. The lead count showing in your data (1 in 28 days) is a tracking artifact from how Shopify reports purchase events, not a real signal about customer interest; purchase volume tells the truer story here. Seven project milestones tied to platform setup, automated flows, and site builds are overdue, and closing those is the current priority so the ad performance has the infrastructure it needs behind it. Once those pieces are live, you can expect more consistent reporting and the subscription and re-engagement flows to begin contributing to revenue.

watch_item.issue: Seven planned deliverables — including automated flows, subscribe pages, and platform setup — are past their due dates, which limits what the ad performance can build on.
watch_item.fix: These items are actively being worked through now, with the subscription lifecycle flows, site restyle, and scaling work all targeted for completion this week.
